title: The Gas Wall
description: Forward-pass gas for five neural nets run inside the EVM, on a log axis against the live Ethereum (60M) and Base (400M) block-gas ceilings. Toggle ML2SC's measured ~106k gas/edge vs an optimized ~1.5k floor, slide the gas price for a USD readout, and watch an MNIST net blow past 180 Ethereum blocks.
controls: hover / focus / tap a bar for exact gas, ×block, and USD
slide gas price to reprice in USD

dataSource.label: ML2SC measured gas (arXiv:2404.16967) + live block limits via Blockscout
